newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Westpac cuts prime rate to 9.75 pct.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Westpac cuts prime rate to 9.75 pct.

text.p: Westpac Banking Corp said on Friday it had cut its reference lending rate for corporate borrowers by 0.5 percentage points to 9.75 percent, effective November 11.
Westpac said it had also cut its business overdraft rate by 50 basis points to 10.25 percent, effective December 17.
Westpac's said its business loans had been reduced by up to 1.00 percentage point.
The action follows the Reserve Bank of Australia's decision on Wednesday to cut official cash rates by 0.5 percentage point to 6.5 percent.
